purpose: This medication is used to treat tension headaches. It combines three ingredients that work together to help relieve the pain and discomfort of headaches. Your doctor may also prescribe it for other types of pain as they see fit.
how_it_works: Butalbital is a mild sedative that helps relax the muscle contractions that can cause tension headaches. Acetaminophen (the same ingredient in Tylenol) is a pain reliever that helps reduce the feeling of pain. Caffeine helps boost the effectiveness of the other two ingredients and can help narrow blood vessels in your head that may be contributing to the headache.
common_side_effects: You may feel drowsy, dizzy, or lightheaded. Some people feel relaxed or a little sedated. Nausea, stomach upset, and feeling short of breath can also happen. Because of the caffeine, some people feel a little jittery or have trouble sleeping if taken late in the day.
warnings: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine — it can seriously increase the risk of liver damage from the acetaminophen and increase sedation from the butalbital. Do not take more than prescribed, as butalbital can be habit-forming and overuse can actually cause more frequent headaches (called medication overuse headache). Do not take other products containing acetaminophen (like Tylenol or cold medicines) at the same time to avoid accidental overdose. Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you know how this medicine affects you. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
typical_dosing: The usual adult dose is 1 to 2 tablets or capsules taken every 4 hours as needed for headache pain. Do not take more than 6 tablets or capsules in a 24-hour period. Always follow exactly what your doctor or prescription label says, and do not take it more often than directed.
